title: Top-support coefficient-sum conjecture for Grothendieck polynomials
statement:
Let $w\in S_n$ and write

$$
\mathfrak{G}_w=\sum_{\alpha\in\mathbb{Z}^n}C_{w\alpha}x^\alpha.
$$

Let $\mathfrak{G}_w^{\mathrm{top}}$ denote the top-degree part of $\mathfrak{G}_w$, and order exponent vectors componentwise. **Top-support coefficient-sum conjecture.** For every $\beta\in\operatorname{supp}(\mathfrak{G}_w^{\mathrm{top}})$,

$$
\sum_{\alpha\leq\beta}C_{w\alpha}=1.
$$

The statement connects the componentwise support poset with Grothendieck-polynomial coefficients; it remains open in general.
source_name: Karola Mészáros, Linus Setiabrata and Avery St. Dizier, “On the support of Grothendieck polynomials”, arXiv:2201.09452 (2022).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2201.09452

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of January 2022).
